messages:
Ana Kim: Quick sync — we need a 60m slot for a combined security/privacy/compliance check-in (threat modeling follow-up + access recert + audit prep). Proposed agenda below. Who can join next week? please react w/ availability + owner for items.

Mike Reynolds: Available Tue/Wed morning PST. +1 for 60m.

Sarah O'Neill: Can we confirm scope — is this primarily an access recert + audit dry-run, or do we need deep threat model walkthroughs?

Ana Kim: Good q. Plan: quick 15m threat-model follow-up (risks only), 20m access recert status + open issues, 20m audit prep (evidence owners & gap list). If we need deeper threat details we can spin out a follow-up.

Josh Patel: I can own audit evidence mapping. Will prepare a short checklist. Need someone from infra for logs/retention.

Priya Desai: I'll own access recert updates and bring the current list. Please add "CSP/data residency checks" to agenda.

sec-bot: poll created — https://poll.com/YN7k3S (Tue 9am / Tue 11am / Wed 10am / Thu 2pm)

Mike Reynolds: Voted Tue 11am. If possible avoid Thu.

Sarah O'Neill: Tue 11am works for me. For threat-model items, can we include the recent token-handling doc link? https://internal.redwood/token-handling

Ana Kim: Added doc to agenda. Draft agenda:
```
1) 5m intro + goals
2) 15m threat-model follow-up (token-handling + mitigations)
3) 20m access recert status (owners: Priya)
4) 20m audit prep & evidence map (owner: Josh)
5) 5m action items + owners
```

Josh Patel: I can share the evidence map before the meeting — will post PR to docs.

Priya Desai: +1, will update recert spreadsheet and flag outstanding approvals.

Ana Kim: Thanks — I'll pick Tue 11am slot if poll holds. Calendar invite will include pre-reads. @sec-bot please add Zoom + recording required flag.

sec-bot: calendar updated — meeting created for Tue 11:00 PST. Zoom link in event. Recording set to mandatory per policy.

Sarah O'Neill: Awesome, I'll skim pre-reads. Quick ask — can we get a short diagram of auth flows in the meeting thread? that helps the threat discussion.

Ana Kim: Good call — @Josh or @Priya can either attach or I can draw a quick 1-slide.

Josh Patel: I can sketch the auth flow and attach before EOD Mon.

Ana Kim: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled — meeting reminder 1 day before.

Mike Reynolds: :thumbsup:
